info.name: FuelPoint API
info.description: FuelPoint API. Run the folders in order, clicking Send on each request (the OTP steps need a code from the server terminal; see the request descriptions). Before the first run set adminPassword in the environment to your seed admin password. Access tokens last 15 minutes: log in again if you get 401. OTP limits: 60 s between requests, 5 per hour per phone number.

request.description: Set the environment variable adminPassword to your SEED_ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD from backend/.env first. The refresh cookie is stored by Postman automatically.
